features.title: Arrange plugin panels in independent layouts
features.summary: Add panels and arrange tab, split, float, move, close, and reset operations independently in the main workbench and right-side pane.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show the workbench header toggle.

features.title: Queue panel-open requests before mount
features.summary: Retain stable panel registrations and early open requests until the matching dock view mounts.
failureModes: A duplicate or missing panel identity cannot silently replace another registration.
